title: ZATAZ: drivers in Alsace report fraudulent card withdrawals after paying at fuel stations; cause not established
date_note: ZATAZ cites DNA reports of 20 November as the first; the page gives no earlier day.
summary: ZATAZ reports drivers in Haut-Rhin and Bas-Rhin found withdrawals of 500 à 1 000 euros after paying for fuel by card, some logged in London and Milan. It cites regional press counting three complaints tied to the Wintzenheim station (DNA, 20 November), five (ici Alsace) and three at Obernai (20 Minutes). The cause is not established; ZATAZ says an isolated incident may be an ordinary terminal problem.
plain: ZATAZ says drivers in Alsace saw fraudulent card withdrawals after paying for fuel. Regional press counts a few complaints per station. The cause is not established.
exec: ZATAZ reports card fraud after fuel-station payments in Alsace, with the cause not established.
action: General advice: check card statements after paying at the pump and report unknown withdrawals to the bank at once.
geo_basis: Wintzenheim (Logelbach) station named by ZATAZ citing DNA; other stations in Alsace also mentioned
